data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1 (5003): a bad-copy fixture lives in the repo and is documented as the dogfood baseline

## Description
Author plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/gov-copy-dogfood-baseline.yaml containing a representative bad-copy Copy Needs section with deliberately:
- Jargon-laden questions (e.g., "Provide your taxpayer identification number per 26 USC 6109")
- Blame-language errors (e.g., "You entered the wrong format")
- Vague hints (e.g., "Please ensure your input is valid")
- Reading level above target (fk_grade >> 8)
- Passive voice prevalence
- At least 5 banned words from the documented banned-word list

The fixture follows the Copy Needs schema (created in story b6cd) but its content quality is intentionally poor — used as the gov-copy-writer's input for end-to-end validation.

A companion README at plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/README.md (or extension of existing) documents this fixture as the dogfood baseline and notes that updates to the canon corpus, banned-word list, or fk_grade threshold may invalidate stale baseline measurements.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Bad-copy fixture exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/gov-copy-dogfood-baseline.yaml
- [ ] Fixture parses as YAML
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/gov-copy-dogfood-baseline.yaml'))"
- [ ] Fixture documented in tests fixtures README
  Verify: grep -q 'gov-copy-dogfood-baseline' plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/README.md

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/gov-copy-dogfood-baseline.yaml | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/README.md | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user
data.title: Author bad-copy fixture documenting baseline jargon/blame/vagueness for dogfood validation
